nonlane_lane_map.note: None = use nonlane_readiness_default (3.0). Reproduces legacy lanes for ride/armbar once technique data is read (P1b).

move_stats.note: P1a reads this table verbatim (the field 'vertical' is never read). P1b switches to data/techniques_v2.json; expected diffs are listed in retire_in_p1b.

technique_data_differences.effect: readiness lane; reproduce with readiness.nonlane_lane_map ground->clinch
seed corrects data to clinch (it is a grip)
none today (never read); seed keeps grounded

kick_ids.export_rule: Keep the exported name KICK_IDS. P1a: exactly this set. From P5: every technique with kind kick or knee in data/techniques_v2.json (a superset; the CLI test only gets stricter).

kick_defense_rules.semantics: Evaluate rules in order; the first rule whose 'when' holds returns (action, outcome). A rule with 'roll' runs that roll only when rng is given; if the roll fails, continue with the next rule. When rng is None the 'no_rng' branch is used. No rule checks training (that is defect B5).

native_defense_rules.semantics: Defaults: missing defense option = defense.block_absorb, missing hands = hands.high_guard. Class 'grapple_entry' = incoming technique in grapple_entry_ids; everything else is 'strike'. For the defender's option take its step list for the class and return the first step whose 'when' holds and (if needs_trained) whose action is in avail_def. If no step returns and fallthrough is true, run the generic list. 'wall_near' means wall_proximity == 'near'.

breakdown_rules.semantics: Per defense option, rules are checked in order and only the FIRST matching rule applies (only defense.outfight has two rules). A rule matches when any condition in when_any holds AND the lane is in 'lanes' ('all' = every lane).

initiative.formula: initiative_base + initiative_per_point*(tempo-3) + mentality_term + (-last_recovery_drag if this fighter attacked last) + fatigue_drag*fatigue + leg_drag*leg_damage + U(-noise, +noise)

mentality.counter.only_when: no exchange yet OR this fighter initiated the previous exchange

initiative.tie_break: max by (score, fighter_id): fighter-ID tie-break (continuous noise makes exact ties practically impossible); P9 replaces with a seeded coin

counter_tendency_rule.rule: counter base = sum of attack_profile.counter_tendency over mentality, defense, hands, stance; defense.outfight's term counts only at kick range and not at the wall

damage_routing.rule: control ids: damage x0.25 and fatigue +0.65 x damage; submissions: damage x0.30, fatigue +0.55 x damage; others: full damage, stamina_drain adds 0.55 x damage fatigue; target.liver_ribs adds 0.22 x damage fatigue on body damage
damage_routing.data_form: technique.damage_routing (control | submission | strike) + target option on_body_damage_extra_fatigue_fraction

slot_plans.explicit_sequence_rule: explicit = [m for m in slot.sequence if m in card_available]; use it unless empty or (karate in slot caps and kicking.karate and len(explicit) <= 3)
slot_plans.slot_moves: active_techniques that are available, != 'escape', kind in (punch, kick, knee, takedown, grip, control, submission) and share a capability with the slot; karate+kicking.karate+mma appends side_kick, teep, body_kick, spinning_back_kick; if empty: available active techniques of kind punch/kick/takedown/grip
slot_plans.after_order: sequence = dedupe(order + slot_moves) filtered to card_available; empty -> ['jab']
slot_plans.abandon_default: max_consecutive_stalls = 999 if the card has one admitted slot else 2
slot_plans.reorder: plans sorted by (home_range != preferred_ranges[0], slot_index); then trigger := fight_start for the first, slot_stalled_or_countered for the rest; next_slot_id := next plan cyclically (card links are overwritten: defect B2)

rules: standing ladder = [kick, punch, clinch]; ground posture forces range ground; boxing forces punch
attacker holding collar/body_lock/single_tie with slot home range kick or punch: defender tie null -> leave to punch automatically; else leave with clinch_exit_probability 0.42; otherwise stay clinch

stepping in one band: entry = sum(entry_delta over mentality, stance, defense, hands, tie, kicking, target) + entry_per_point*(tempo-3); distance = sum(distance_control_delta over the defender's same 7 dims, excluding defense.outfight at the wall) - 0.65 at the wall - 0.12*leg damage; p = clamp(sigmoid(entry - distance + 0.35), 0.18, 0.82); failure drifts the defender 0.28 m toward the wall in walled arenas
stepping out one band: p = 0.72 if mentality.outboxer or defense.outfight else 0.58, -0.20 when the attacker is at the wall
filtered = sequence without 'escape' and, once kick_checks_suffered >= 2, without low_kick and body_kick (falls back to the full sequence if empty)

range match: technique reaches if the range is in its required_range (but never double_leg/single_leg at kick range), or at punch range if 'close' is in its required_range, or it is one of low_kick/body_kick/teep/switch_kick, or the attacker's tie is tie.greco/tie.judo_sambo and it is body_lock/outside_trip/collar_tie
pick = range-matched list (else filtered) at slot_Cursor modulo length; the cursor advances every exchange

ground: top with ride available -> ride; bottom with armbar -> armbar; else escape if available; else top strikes [cross, hook, body_hook, jab, haymaker] at the cursor; else retreat, then pummel, then jab
kick range and the pick is not in KICK_IDS: pick from [side_kick, teep, low_kick, body_kick, jab] that are available, at the cursor
recent moves window = 6; consecutive repeats feed read memory
feint chance = min(0.55, sum of feint_setup_rate over mentality, stance, hands, target)
base <= 0 -> zero-damage record
region overrides: single_leg -> leg; body_kick with kicking.karate on an odd slot cursor -> head; regions other than head/body/leg -> head for head_kick/axe_kick/jumping_knee, else body
stance.crouch +0.06 power on hook/body_hook/uppercut; stance.switch +0.08 when 'switch_step' is in setups (never true today)

kicking power_delta applies to KICK_IDS when the lane is a kicking favored lane or the id is in [side_kick, spinning_back_kick, axe_kick, teep, low_kick, body_kick, head_kick, knee_body, jumping_knee]
target power_delta applies when the lane is a target favored lane, or head_hunter+head, body_puncher/liver_ribs+body, leg_chopper+leg, knee_clincher+[knee_body, jumping_knee, collar_tie]
hands power_delta always; tie power_delta when the lane is clinch/entry/single_support; counter_hit adds counter_power_delta of mentality, hands and defense
slot delta = depth multiplier - 1 in the active slot, else -0.15; wear = -0.012*fatigue - (0.03 if kick else 0.015)*leg damage; attacker clamp [0.75, 1.75]

landing x1.12 at the wall; guard = 1.14 - 0.06*coverage (defender hands mma_adaptation ratings: head_coverage/body_coverage/takedown_readiness); block_absorb: blocked landing 0.24, head guard x0.90; defender = max(0.60, guard*(1 + 0.045*region damage))
checked low_kick/body_kick/switch_kick recoil = base*0.65*attacker multiplier onto the kicker's leg
damage_rules.data_forms: stance.crouch power_bonus_for {techniques, delta}; stance.switch power_bonus_after_setup; target options target_power_match {regions, techniques}; technique field check_recoil; model.damage.tie_power_lanes

caught_kick.rule: on 'caught': kicker kick_checks_suffered += 1; sweep p = clamp(0.62 - (tie + stance sweep_resistance) - 0.04*holder fatigue, 0.18, 0.68); dump technique = sanda_sweep if available else outside_trip else cross (clean); resistance >= 0.12 -> over_under clinch, else ground with holder half_guard_top / kicker closed_guard_bottom

counter_candidates.rule: first available of: kick range [side_kick, teep, low_kick, body_kick, cross, jab]; clinch [knee_body, uppercut, body_hook, outside_trip, hook]; otherwise [cross, uppercut, hook, body_hook, jab, haymaker]; quality counter_hit with p 0.62 else partial

posture_rules.rule: ground -> height grounded, base mat; recovery window single_leg_recovery -> base single_leg; leg damage >= 4.0 with rear_heavy -> front_heavy

legacy.inventory: reference/literal_inventory.json lists every remaining option-id and technique-id literal by line and function (93 option literals on 76 lines; 364 technique literals on 186 lines incl. the MOVE_BASE_STATS/KICK_IDS tables)

decision.tie_break: max by (score, fighter_id): fighter-ID tie-break (defect D7)

laterality.natural_definition: A fighter is NATURAL when the dominant hand and dominant leg are on the REAR side of their current stance (orthodox: right; southpaw: left). Natural fighters get ZERO dominance deltas, so every card without a laterality block (and every D3 default) behaves exactly as today.

missing_block.dominant_hand: rear side of the card orientation (switching -> orthodox, i.e. right)

laterality.switching_rule: When a fighter changes stance mid-fight (switch_step, stance.switch, forced switch from leg damage) the rear side changes, so a natural fighter becomes cross-dominant until they switch back.
laterality.power_applies_to: attacker additive sum (damage) for punches/elbows by hand side and kicks/knees by leg side; techniques with side 'both' or 'none' get 0
laterality.state_fields: Store side damage in a NEW actor field damage_by_side {head_left, head_right, body_left, body_right, leg_left, leg_right, arm_left, arm_right}; keep actor.damage {head, body, leg} as the totals (fight_state_v2 closes that object).

grappling_side_preference.note: Research links grappling side preference to footedness; leave off until P6 is stable.

grappling.profile_scale_note: grappling_profile values are 0-5 like engine_index ratings; contest uses (actor_skill - opponent_skill + modifiers)
grappling.null_tie_note: Used when a card's tie dimension is null. tie.null is NOT an option (option_behaviors.json must keep exactly 57 options).
grappling.scramble_rule: If |roll - p| < scramble_margin on a takedown or stand-up contest, the pair goes to the transition's via_outcome target (scramble or turtle) instead of success/failure.

submission.on_escape: apply the transition row with contest 'submission' from the current position (failed attempt), else stay

vertical.gating: a technique with vertical_min V is usable only if V is in modes[fight vertical_mode] AND V is in card.airborne_training.allowed_vertical_modes AND (technique.requires_airborne_training is false OR the id is in card.airborne_training.techniques)

knockdowns.event_fields: Record knockdowns in new exchange fields (knockdown, standing_count); the outcome enum of exchange_event_v2 is closed.

energy.note: Average energy_mult over a typical exchange mix is ~1.0 so tempo calibration roughly holds. accuracy_per_fatigue_point stays 0.0 (fatigue already lowers readiness and damage) until an audit asks for it.

features.seq_next: 1 if the technique is the slot sequence item at the slot pointer, else 0. The pointer starts at 0 on every slot entry and advances by one each time the slot throws its pointed item (any result); it wraps.
features.seq_other: 1 if the technique is elsewhere in the active slot's sequence, else 0
features.target_pref: 1 if technique.attack_lane is in the favored_lanes of the card's target option (or of its kicking option, for kicks and knees), else 0
features.range_fit: 1.0 if the current range equals technique.required_range[0]; 0.6 if it is another listed range
features.open_seam: 1 if the defender's readiness on technique.attack_lane (this exchange's profile) is below open_seam_readiness_below, else 0
features.debt_exploit: 1 if the technique is in the effective technique_ids (base + v2 overlay) of a debt of the opponent (opponent options' exploitable_debt_ids + card exploitable_seams) whose ruleset includes this ruleset and whose required_range is within one band of the current range
features.repeats: how many of this fighter's last 3 attacks used this technique (0-3)
features.combo_follow_up: 1 if (previous own technique, this technique) are consecutive in a combination chain whose school is one of the active slot's capabilities and whose trigger_on matches the previous exchange's result
features.signature: 1 if the technique is in card.signature_moves
features.momentum: fight_momentum * commit(t), where commit(t) = min(1, recovery_exposure.readiness_penalty / 0.8)
features.goal_alignment: 1 if the technique satisfies goal_predicates[slot.goal], else 0

goal_predicates.counter_trap: usage in (counter, both) OR kind == feint OR 'recovery' in exploits_openings
goal_predicates.clinch_control: kind in (grip, knee, elbow) and 'clinch' in required_range
goal_predicates.submission_finish: kind == submission OR id == guard_pull OR result_position in (closed_guard, back_control, mount)
goal_predicates.position: kind in (grip, control) OR result_position is not null

selection.candidate_pool: active slot pool (slot grants via core + active_techniques, plus basic_movement core) INTERSECT legal in ruleset INTERSECT vertical gating INTERSECT reachable now (range, position role, grips, wall), usage in (attack, both, movement); counter-only techniques excluded
empty_pool_policy: standing and current range != slot home_range: choose step (to close) or retreat (to open) toward home range
in a clinch or ground position: choose the first trained escape for the actor's role (clinch_break, stand_up, technical_standup, hip_escape)
selection.sampling: p_i = softmax(score_i / temperature); one rng.random() draw per choice; candidates sorted by technique id before sampling so order never depends on dict iteration
selection.counter_choice: same scorer over trained techniques with usage in (counter, both, attack) that reach at the current range; counter-only techniques are eligible only here

slot_triggers.evaluation: At the start of each exchange, before selection. Triggers are evaluated from state and the previous exchange record.

predicates.fight_start: the slot active at exchange 1 (exactly one slot per card should carry it; if none, the first slot)
predicates.slot_stalled: the active slot's abandon rule fired this exchange
predicates.slot_stalled_or_countered: same as slot_stalled (being countered already counts as a stall)
predicates.opponent_kicks: the opponent's last attack (within the last 2 exchanges) was a kick or knee
predicates.opponent_commits: the opponent's last attack had recovery_exposure.readiness_penalty >= commit_penalty_min
predicates.opponent_enters: the opponent closed the range by one band in the previous exchange
predicates.opponent_circles_out: the opponent used pivot or retreat in 2 of their last 3 actions
predicates.opponent_clinches_or_shoots: the opponent attempted a grip, takedown or sweep in the previous exchange, or the pair position is a clinch/transition position where the opponent holds the dominant role
predicates.self_hurt: own head damage >= hurt_head_damage OR stunned OR knocked down this round
predicates.opponent_hurt: opponent head damage >= hurt_head_damage OR stunned
predicates.late_fight: elapsed time >= late_fight_fraction of the scheduled fight
predicates.behind_on_score: own running decision score < opponent's by >= behind_margin

stall_conditions.sequence_denied_or_countered: an own attack from this slot ends miss/evaded/blocked/checked/caught/jammed, or the fighter is counter-hit; the count resets when an own attack lands partial or better
stall_conditions.kicks_blocked_or_jammed: an own kick or knee ends blocked/checked/caught/jammed
stall_conditions.clinch_denied_or_escaped: an own grip/takedown attempt fails or the opponent escapes a clinch position
stall_conditions.pocket_stalled: two consecutive exchanges at punch or close range without an own landed attack

switching: If the abandon rule fired: go to the first slot in links whose trigger holds; if none holds, the first slot in links; if links is empty, the next slot by index (wrapping).

Otherwise a linked slot whose trigger is reactive (any trigger except fight_start and slot_stalled*) and holds pre-empts, but only after the active slot has run min_exchanges_before_preempt exchanges.

A slot with goal reset_to_home_range: while it is active, defenses granted by its capabilities move to the front of every applicable defense list; when the pair is back at standing_neutral and at the card's preferred_ranges[0], follow its links.

pace.gap_uses: initiating fighter's tempo and mentality patience

fight_momentum.state_field: actor.fight_momentum (scalar). Do NOT reuse actor.momentum: fight_state_v2 defines it as a 2-number vector.

defense_contest.formula: after the hit roll fails: p = clamp(sigmoid(slope * (readiness[lane] - offense + defense_fit)), lo, hi); success -> the defense technique's result for this class; failure -> failure_result
defense_contest.kick_catch: kick_catch uses the catch roll (technique.catchability) instead of this contest; a failed catch is 'blocked'

ground_strike_defense.note: ground strikes are defended by the position (no technique pick)

defense_contest.selection: Build the ordered list: kicking option kick_defense_prepend[class] + hands option defense_prepend[class] + defense option native_defense.by_class[class] (or at_wall[class] when wall_near and present). Remove duplicates, keep trained techniques, take the first; if none, retreat. With rng=None the legacy entry points return this first pick and its success result (no roll).
incoming_class_rules: kind in (movement, feint, defense, control, escape) -> none (no defense step), unless technique.incoming_class overrides
kind == submission -> submission (staged escape rolls, no defense pick)
kind == kick: lane in (leg, single_support) -> kick_low; lane starts with head -> kick_high; line in (lead_linear_kick, rear_linear_kick) -> kick_linear; else kick_body
kind == punch: lane == body -> body_punch; line in (lead_uppercut, rear_uppercut) -> uppercut; line in (lead_round, rear_round, overhand, spinning) -> hook; else straight

kick_defense_window.rule: kicks and knees except knee_body take the kick-defense path when roll > max(0.10, p_land - window); window = base + sum of option kick_defense_window_delta (additive, replaces legacy tiers in P5)

geometry.band_from_distance: nearest band by distance; ground positions override to range 'ground'
geometry.pivot_rule: rotate the opponent around the pivoting fighter by pivot_angle_deg * arena.lateral_freedom
geometry.wall_rule: wall_proximity = near when distance to the closest wall < arena.wall_near_m; in_corner when two walls are within wall_near_m

edge_fall.trigger: a fighter ends an exchange beyond the edge
edge_fall.on_fall: fight ends, method 'Fall (ring-out)'; otherwise the fighter is pulled back to the edge with balance off_base

geometry.preset_fields: Keep every existing arena_presets field in data/model_v2.json and keep exporting ARENA_PRESETS (the test checks its six keys). New fields are additive.

finishes.tiebreak: No draws (the CLI test requires a winner). If decision scores are equal within 1e-9, draw one rng.random() in canonical order: < 0.5 -> first canonical fighter wins. Record result.decision_tiebreak = true.
finishes.decision: per round with ruleset decision_weights (clean_strikes, damage, control, aggression); fight winner = more rounds won, then total score, then the tiebreak above

director.no_win: If the requested winner wins none of the runs, return no fight and say so (never return a losing run).

mastery.decision: D23; mechanics in handoff 7.18; calibrated by RANK_MASTERY_STRESS_TEST.md (562,880 fights on 0d0734d)
mastery.effective_level: slot level = mean level of the slot's capabilities except basic_movement (none left -> card rank); attacker: the slot it attacks from; defender: the slot it last attacked from (start: fight_start slot)
mastery.school_mastery_rule: rank is a ceiling: no school above the card's rank; unlisted schools sit at the card's rank
mastery.calibrated_on: 0d0734d; holdout seeds: +1 68.1% (same style) / 65.9% (different styles), +2 83.6% / 78.8%, +3 92.4% / 88.8%. Re-calibrate at P13 (handoff 10.16).
